description: Infer a log format from sample lines and deliver a Python parser module that extracts timestamps, addresses and bracketed fields, plus the parsed samples as JSON. When you have sample logs and want a working parser rather than a regex to write by hand. Do not choose this when the log format is already known and a library parser exists. Example requests: Write me a parser for this log format. | Generate a Python module that parses these log lines. | What fields can be extracted from these logs?

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

samples.description: The customer's samples.log, as text. Supported: Plain text, one record per line. Sample log lines, one per line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_log_format_parser
title: Log format parser generator
